purpose: What the model is ASKED under targeted_v5_batch. The prompt's SHA-256 enters the replay cache key and the BatchQuestionId on every batched answer, so an unpinned template can invalidate every recording ever made and report it as a missing recording.
boundary: The RENDERED prompt, not the file that renders it. Comments, renames and refactors do not change what is asked and must not fail this contract; a different question must. The inputs are pinned here beside the hashes they produce, because a pin whose inputs live elsewhere can be made to pass by editing the inputs.
governance: A rendered prompt that changes is a NEW PROMPT VERSION: add a profile in tools/extraction_profile.py and a contract file for it. Updating a hash here so an edited prompt passes turns every recording into a replay miss with nothing to say why. This file's own bytes are pinned in tests/test_contract_pins.py and published in docs/acceptance/gate_versions.md, so editing it is visible.
